item.title: DevPulse 0.15.0
item.description:
• Search the quick launcher by words from a title: it finds your pull requests, tickets and Claude Code sessions with every word at once, then the tickets of your Jira projects and the pull requests of your repositories with those words, as Jira and GitHub answer. Case and accents do not matter.
  • Settings › General › Appearance: System, Light or Dark for the popover, the launcher and the windows.
  • The launcher's search bar is Liquid Glass, like Spotlight's; the results sit on a card below it.
